name: Store Locations Map
author: Nahiro.net - Wordpress Hilfe & Support

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress pages with the Store Locations Map plugin! This plugin allows you to display a vector map with locations using shortcodes, making it versatile for use across any WordPress theme. Customize each location with markers, titles, images, descriptions, and links. Choose from a variety of map styles and tailor the map’s appearance to match your site’s design. Perfect for showcasing multiple store locations on your website!

Features

  • Include Maps from: Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Poland, Portugal, Spain, and more.
  • Fast and lightweight.
  • Excellent resolution on any screen.
  • Active languages: English, German, Spanish.
  • Uses shortcodes for easy integration.

WordPress Hilfe & Support – Nahiro.net

Store Locations Map Pro

With the premium version of this plugin, you can add unlimited markers and access more customization options.

Store Locations Map Pro
sections.installation:
1. Extract the contents of the .zip file and upload store-locations-map to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Create a new map and add it using the shortcode [store-locations-map id=""] to your desired page or post. (The specific shortcode is found in the edit page of the map)
